items.title: Add a default per-command timeout in validation-executor.ts (kill hung command, exit 124, attributed)
items.context: packages/main/src/core/validation-executor.ts: introduce DEFAULT_VALIDATE_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS (below the cli-engine 300s global idle watchdog) and use it when command.timeoutMs is unset/<=0, so the SIGTERM/SIGKILL timer always arms; keep explicit per-command timeoutMs override. The timed-out command must finish with code 124 and an attributable message.

items.title: Add a smoke proving the default timeout kills a hung command and spares a normal one
items.context: New packages/main/src/tasks/validate-command-timeout-smoke.ts (repo smoke convention): a command that sleeps past the default ceiling is killed and reported as timed-out (exit 124); a fast command completes normally. tsc + node smoke green.
